dict.string: CleanerMac scans your Desktop folder to find large, old, or duplicate files and empty folders you may want to move to the Trash.
CleanerMac scans your Documents folder to find large, old, or duplicate files and empty folders you may want to move to the Trash.
CleanerMac scans your Downloads folder to find duplicate files, old files, and stalled or incomplete downloads you may want to move to the Trash.
CleanerMac scans removable drives only when you explicitly add a folder from an external volume to Scan Roots to find duplicate, large, or old files.
CleanerMac scans network shares only when you explicitly add a folder from a mounted network volume to Scan Roots to find duplicate, large, or old files.
